options.title: Desk Flight
options.logline: A sticky note folds itself into a plane and carries one word across the desk.

look.description: Flat paper cut-out on a warm desk with soft top light.

shots.text: Two folds turn it into a dart.
Launch; the word rides the wing.
It lands as the period of the closing line.

signatureMoves: The plane lands as a period
options.audio: Soft ticks and a whoosh; no score
options.risk: The fold reads as a jump cut.
options.whyItFits: The literal journey makes the takeaway readable on mute.

options.title: Paper Grain
options.logline: The same flight told in close textures: every crease and shadow is the story.

look.description: Macro paper texture, warm amber grade, rim light on the folds.

options.stack: Canvas 2D with layered grain + synthesized SFX

shots.text: Push in on the note's orange corner.
Low-angle crane up as the plane launches.
Close-up landing on the closing line.

signatureMoves: Crease shadows sweep like a wipe
options.audio: Paper ticks and a soft whoosh
options.whyItFits: Texture makes a tiny object feel cinematic.

options.title: One Long Glide
options.logline: A single unbroken take follows the plane from fold to landing.

shots.text: One continuous move: fold, launch, glide, land.

signatureMoves: Camera hands off from desk to sky to notebook
options.audio: Continuous airy pad with a single tick
options.risk: A long take feels slow at 8s.
options.whyItFits: A long take turns a small action into a journey.

chosen.notes: Keep the four-shot structure from A's timing.
